subject: MPA: staging evidence lane and retention questions for HelixBank
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Martin Lee <security@helixbank.com>; Sara Patel <procurement@helixbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MPA: staging evidence lane and retention questions for HelixBank

Hi Martin / Sara —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our mutual action plan for HelixBank (attached draft MAP in HubSpot), a few quick clarifications we need so we can lock the close timeline:

1) SOC 2: you asked for our latest Type II report. We can provide the 2026 Type II summary now and full report under NDA. Is there a preferred recipient for the full PDF and an internal mailbox to accept evidence?

2) SIG / CAIQ: we finished the CAIQ answers for the evaluation scope (staging + production-lite). I've attached the spreadsheet stub here — can you confirm whether Helix intends to run the full CAIQ or just the subset for data residency and key controls?

3) DPA redlines: Sara, you mentioned legal wanted a few clarifications on data retention language for evaluation logs. Our default eval retention window is 90 days (logs and KV cache metadata). We can offer a 30-day retention for evaluation-only workloads as a contract carveout if that helps accelerate signoff. Is that acceptable to Helix legal?

4) Evidence staging lane: Jonas and I propose a brief staging evidence review week (3 business days) during the pilot to reduce back-and-forth on artifacts. Would Helix prefer an on-site walkthrough or remote session with screen share and sampled artifacts?

Next steps: if you can confirm SOC2 delivery recipient, CAIQ scope, and retention preference (90 vs 30 days) by EOD Monday we’ll update the MAP milestones and push the DocuSign link for the DPA redline.

Attachments: CAIQ-answers-helixbank.xlsx (stub)

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Martin Lee <security@helixbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <procurement@helixbank.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA: staging evidence lane and retention questions for HelixBank

Grace —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers below:

1) SOC 2: please send the Type II summary to security@helixbank.com. For the full report, we will need it under an NDA; I can share our standard NDAnow if that’s easiest.

2) CAIQ: For our eval we only need the subset covering data residency, access controls, encryption, and logging. If you can mark those tabs in the CAIQ spreadsheet and export, that will save time.

3) Retention: Helix legal prefers 30 days for evaluation logs. We understand production defaults may be longer; the carveout for the pilot would be sufficient to close procurement. Please note we’ll want confirmation in the DPA redline.

4) Evidence staging review: remote screen-share + sampled artifact upload is fine. We’d like to schedule the 3-day window the week of June 21 to align with our security SME availability.

Attachments: DPA-redline-helixbank-v3.docx (stub)

—
Martin Lee
Head of Security, HelixBank
security@helixbank.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Martin Lee <security@helixbank.com>, Sara Patel <procurement@helixbank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA: staging evidence lane and retention questions for HelixBank

Martin / Sara —

Thanks — confirming Redwood can:

- Deliver the SOC 2 Type II summary to security@helixbank.com today. We will provide the full Type II under NDA. If you send the NDA to legal@redwood.com I’ll loop in compliance to execute.

- Export a trimmed CAIQ that highlights the data residency, access control, encryption, and logging tabs. Grace will attach that slice to the MAP.

- Accept the 30-day evaluation log retention as a contract carveout for the pilot. We’ll add explicit language to the DPA redline to reflect: 30 days for evaluation log artifacts (defined as request/response traces and KV cache metadata), standard 90/365 production retention to remain unchanged.

I’ll also propose a minor change to the MAP: add a "staging evidence acceptance" milestone (3 business days) immediately after pilot deployment, with an optional escalation point to a technical walkthrough if samples fail initial checks. Proposed dates below — feel free to adjust.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
- June 21: pilot deployment to staging + evidence upload window opens
- June 22–24: staging evidence acceptance (3 business days)
- June 25: final acceptance decision / signoff and DocuSign kick for DPA

We’ll be ready to accept the DPA redline in DocuSign once Sara confirms procurement runbook.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026-summary.pdf (stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Martin Lee <security@helixbank.com>, Sara Patel <procurement@helixbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA: staging evidence lane and retention questions for HelixBank

Perfect — thanks everyone.

Action items I’ll take:
- Send the SOC2 Type II summary to security@helixbank.com now (done).
- Attach the trimmed CAIQ slice to the MAP in HubSpot and add the staging evidence milestone as Kimberly suggested.
- Update the DPA redline to include the 30-day eval retention carveout and add the DocuSign link.
- Block the June 22–24 window for the staging evidence review and propose a 45-minute kickoff on June 21 to align on samples and SME availability.

Martin / Sara — can you confirm the kickoff time on June 21 (morning PT or afternoon PT)? Once I have that I’ll send calendar invites and the DocuSign envelope for the DPA.

Thanks —
Grace

—
